snippet.title: Concrete Carnage: Scrapheap - Official Announcement Teaser
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam : 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4913000/Concrete_Carnage_Scrapheap/
Welcome to Concrete Carnage: Scrapheap. Drive trucks through a post-apocalyptic giscardpunk world. Crush pedestrians, destroy your rivals, haul cargo. No weapons — just tons of steel. The brutality of 90s games, no compromise.
